## Data & Method

- Constructed a collaboration network using 2020–2024 Melon Chart data.
- Performed centrality metrics analysis to identify key influencers and emergent genre networks within the K-Pop industry.
- Bipartite projection, analysed in igraph and visualised with visNetwork.
